沖韓亭.name: Okikantei
沖韓亭.desc: An unusual shop that, despite being a Korean restaurant, for some reason also serves Okinawa soba. A gentle broth made by simmering pork, chicken and vegetables for 10 hours, with medium-thick wavy noodles, topped with melt-in-your-mouth soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki).
t: I ate here in December 2023. This shop is a participant in the "13th Okinawa Soba Stamp Rally (2023.10.1 to 2024.2.29)," and I went as my 28th of 34 shops😊
Okikantei
As the shop name and sign say, this place is a Korean restaurant, yet for some reason it also has Okinawa soba (^0^;)　It's my first time experiencing a shop like this😁
Inside the shop　The bottles on the wall on the left side of the photo seem to be Korean liquor lol
Menu
Menu
As expected, the menu is mostly Korean food, but then suddenly, for some reason, there's an Okinawa soba menu😄
This time I ordered the "nankotsu soki soba" introduced in the stamp rally booklet.
Soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) soba large　¥780

First, the soup. I was savoring it thinking it was a gentle broth with a strong bonito base?, but when I later looked at the stamp rally description, it said "Please savor our broth made by simmering pork, chicken and vegetables for 10 hours" (^0^;).

"Was it chicken broth?" I lost confidence (^0^;)　Sorry for my clueless taste buds (^0^;)　But when I was drinking the soup I thought it was bonito, so maybe there's bonito broth in it too. Sorry, I'm not confident (^0^;)
Soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) soba large　¥780
Next, the noodles. Medium-thick wavy noodles. They're on the soft side.
The soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) topping is fairly large and simmered until melt-in-your-mouth.
Perfectly tasty😆

Rating (9/15): Perfectly tasty. The light, gentle broth and the melt-in-your-mouth soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) are delicious. Also, the parking lot was behind the shop, but it seemed to have only a few spaces. When I googled it, there was information that parking at a nearby paid lot would be free, but I couldn't figure out where a coin parking lot was in the area.

浜屋そば.name: Hamaya Soba
浜屋そば.desc: A shop popular on social media with lines out the door, near Miyagi Coast (a surfing and diving spot). A light salt-based soup with bone-in pork ribs (hon-soki) and seared soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki). It also runs the food truck "Tomoyan-kun."
t: This shop is popular on social media and elsewhere😊　I ate here for the first time in quite a while (May 2023)
"Hamaya" is a popular shop, and there's always a line at lunchtime lol
Menu
I ordered the "Hamaya Soba," which has the same name as the shop
Hamaya soba large　¥850

First, a sip of the soup. It's a light flavor with just a touch of pork bone, different from other shops' soups😊　The noodles are medium-thick, and the bone-in pork ribs (hon-soki) and seared soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) toppings also seem to be seasoned with salt, so it's on the light side.

Rating (9/15): Perfectly tasty. It's a popular shop with lines even on weekdays, but turnover is decent, so I think you'll get in after a short wait. There seem to be 2 parking spaces beside the shop and 7 a little way away, but this time I parked far down along the seawall on the coastal road^^;　This sea (Miyagi Coast) is popular for diving on days with no waves and as a surf point when there are waves, so there's a lot of street parking along the seawall too. They also seem to run a food truck, so you could probably eat there without lining up😊
I parked far away on the road along the seawall and walked to Hamaya^^;　It's one of the prefecture's top diving and surf spots😊
There's also the food truck "Tomoyan-kun"😊
Recently the food truck has been in the parking lot of a commercial facility in Okinawa City😊

浦添そば.name: Urasoe Soba
浦添そば.desc: A locally popular shop along Route 330. Its soki soba with a strong bonito broth is distinctive for the fuchiba (mugwort) scattered over it, and the self-service mini sata andagi after your meal is a nice touch.
t: I ate here in March 2023😊
Urasoe Soba (along Route 330)
I had the "soki soba"😊
Soki soba　¥800
The soup has a strong bonito broth, and the noodles are the thin type. It's soki soba, but it had fuchiba (mugwort) scattered over it, which no other shop has😁
Eaten together with the noodles, the mugwort flavor is really nice and delicious. The soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) are melt-in-your-mouth and tasty too😋
What's more, mini sata andagi (Okinawan doughnuts) are set out self-service for after your meal, which is great service😄

Rating (9/15): Perfectly tasty. It's close to the spring training ballpark of the pro baseball team Yakult Swallows, so why not visit while sightseeing? I went in at lunchtime, and it was bustling with local customers.

浮島ＢＡＳＥ.name: Ukishima BASE
浮島ＢＡＳＥ.desc: A stylish new shop near Kokusai-dori. Its signature is the nankotsu soba with a pork bone-based soup, where you can choose between fresh noodles (chewy) and regular noodles. The menu is extensive, from champuru and pork bone soup to desserts.
t: I ate here in March 2024😄
Ukishima BASE (so stylish😁)
Ukishima BASE (so stylish😁)
It was lunchtime, and the shop was full of customers, but after waiting a while I was told "Please come in" and shown to a counter seat😄
Menu
Menu (besides Okinawa soba dishes, there's champuru too)
Menu (miso soup loaded with ingredients and pork bone soup too lol)
Menu (there are all sorts of things besides Okinawa soba dishes)
Menu (there are desserts too)

This time I ordered the "nankotsu soba." You can choose between two kinds of noodles, "fresh noodles (chewy texture)" and "regular noodles (noodles that cling to the soup)," and I chose the "fresh noodles."
Nankotsu soba　¥800
The "nankotsu soba" is here. Judging from the color, I wondered if the soup was pork bone-based as I took a sip.
As expected, it was pork bone-based😁　It's perfectly tasty.
Nankotsu soba　¥800
Next, the noodles. Medium-thin noodles with fairly good firmness.
The soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) are jiggly and tender, and the seasoning is on the light side.
Rating (9/15): Perfectly tasty. It's close to Kokusai-dori, so why not try it when you're nearby while sightseeing? The inside of the shop felt new and stylish, perhaps because it had just opened.

海老そばとwine PARMI.name: Ebi Soba to wine PARMI
海老そばとwine PARMI.desc: Shrimp soba by day and a wine bar by night, a double act. Its signature is the limited 5-servings-a-day "Ebi Zanmai -Kiwami-" with a rich, creamy soup made from a pork bone base and 20 shrimp. Luxurious toppings including two head-on shrimp and chashu.
t: *This article was created with AI (ChatGPT 4o), with some additions of my own😁
I ate here in November 2024😆 This time I visited "Ebi Soba to wine PARMI" in Omoromachi, Naha City.
Ebi Soba to wine PARMI
Ebi Soba to wine PARMI
As the name says, this shop serves soba featuring shrimp, and it's a soba shop with a unique style where you can also enjoy wine, especially at night.
The lunch menu is shrimp soba, and the dinner menu is a wine bar😆
The inside has a calm atmosphere, a space like a stylish bar, with wine bottles lined up on the counter. Being able to enjoy wine at an Okinawa soba shop is quite a rare concept🍷✨.
The mini bottles of liquor on the counter are cute😆
There are lots of wine bottles too
Menu (the limited 5-servings-a-day "Ebi Zanmai -Kiwami-"😆)
Menu (an explanation of the difference between Ebi Zanmai and shrimp soba. Ebi Zanmai is the top one👍)
Menu (the "Rich Shrimp Miso Soba" looks delicious too😄)
Menu
Menu (besides shrimp broth, there's also shellfish broth and bonito broth)
Menu (side dishes. Dangerous for calories (^0^;))
An explanation of the parking
A panel explaining their commitment to the shrimp soba
Ebi Zanmai -Kiwami-　¥1,600

What I had this time was the limited 5-servings-a-day "Ebi Zanmai -Kiwami-" for ¥1,600😄. As the name suggests, it was a bowl that lets you enjoy shrimp to the fullest. The soup is made from a pork bone base with broth drawn from 20 shrimp, giving it a very creamy, rich finish🦐. It's packed with the umami of shrimp, and I could also taste a spicy accent🔥. The soup is frothy😆
Ebi Zanmai -Kiwami-　¥1,600

The noodles are medium-thick, gently wavy fresh noodles🍜. They have a chewy texture, and with every bite you can faintly taste the flavor of the wheat and a hint of salt. They cling well to the soup, picking up the rich shrimp soup nicely. Unlike traditional Okinawa soba noodles, they're closer to a ramen style.

The toppings were very luxurious too✨. Two large head-on shrimp, a seasoned egg, four slices of chashu, plus two pieces of melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly (sanmai-niku), and small shrimp scattered over it, a volume truly worthy of the name "Ebi Zanmai (shrimp galore)"🦐🍖. However, what was disappointing was the seasoned egg and the chashu🥚. They were cold, as if just taken out of the fridge, and the gap with the temperature of the soup bothered me a bit❄️. If they'd taken the extra step of warming them, it might have been a more unified bowl.

Rating (9/15): I got the impression the menu was a little similar to that of "Kaidashi Okinawa Soba Kiseki.", which I visited the other day during my stamp rally rounds🤔. Both are seafood-style Okinawa soba, characterized by a creamy soup. However, personally I felt Kiseki's soup was better put together and more polished. PARMI's shrimp soba is delicious too, but the cold toppings ended up being a bit of a letdown. I'm sorry, but I ended up thinking "Kaidashi Okinawa Soba Kiseki." was tastier🙏

玉屋そば jr 名護店.name: Tamaya Soba jr Nago Branch
玉屋そば jr 名護店.desc: The Nago branch (along Route 449) that calls itself the "Second-Generation Okinawa Soba King." A light, clear soup with a choice of flat or thin noodles, and the all-you-can-take fuchiba (mugwort) is its specialty. Try the mixed soba with tender simmered pork spare ribs (soki) and braised pork belly (sanmai-niku).
t: It was introduced in the "Nago City Soba Map," so I ate here in January 2021😄
Tamaya Soba jr Nago Branch (along Route 449)
"Tamaya Soba jr Nago Branch" is introduced as shop 35 of 41 in the "Nago Soba Map"
I ordered the "mixed soba" introduced on the map. According to the map, it's the "Second-Generation Okinawa Soba King" and its selling point seems to be fuchiba (mugwort).
Mixed soba　¥700

A light, clear soup, and you can choose flat or thin noodles; this time I went with the thin noodles, which are the popular choice😄　The pork spare ribs (soki) and braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) toppings are simmered tender too😋　Just what you'd expect from the 2nd-generation Okinawa Soba King lol　The all-you-can-take fuchiba (mugwort) is also a great accent and the best. I feel like it instantly makes it zero calories and healthy😁
Rating (9/15): As the "Second-Generation Okinawa Soba King," it's a shop you'll want to check out😁　It's perfectly tasty, so please do give it a try.
